theme: 9:30 retest probability conditioned on multiple signals
purpose: Quantify how the baseline 90% retest rate shifts under different conditions: wide-body 9:30, 200MA regime, regime-change days, VWAP confluence.

conditional_results.verdict: Modest +3pp uplift over baseline. Confirms intuition but small effect.
No edge from regime filter — retest rates are essentially identical to baseline.

conditional_results.warning: Tiny sample (n=18) — 232-day window is overwhelmingly bull regime
conditional_results.verdict: No meaningful difference, but sample too small to be definitive.

conditional_results.warning: Only 4 such days in 233-day sample — anecdotal at best
conditional_results.verdict: Suggestive of slower retests on regime-change days but sample inadequate.

conditional_results.condition: VWAP confluence (9:30 high or low within 0.1% of session VWAP at 10:00)
conditional_results.verdict: Strongest finding. +7pp uplift over baseline. VWAP confluence dramatically increases retest probability — magnetic effect of multiple price levels lining up.
Without VWAP nearby, retest rate drops 5pp below baseline.

key_findings.1: VWAP confluence is the strongest filter — pushes retest probability from 90% (baseline) to 97% (with confluence). 11pp swing between confluence and no-confluence days.
key_findings.2: Wide-body 9:30 modestly boosts retest probability (+3pp). Confirms intuition but smaller than expected.
key_findings.3: 200MA regime barely matters for retest probability — both above and below MA show similar rates. The 232-day sample is heavily skewed toward bull regime (215 above vs 18 below).
key_findings.4: Regime-change days appear to have slower retests but sample is only 4 days — anecdotal.

sample_size_caveats: 232-233 day window. Tiny sub-samples (regime-change=4, below MA=18) cannot be acted on. Larger conditions (wide-body=102, vwap=97) have ~±5pp confidence intervals. The +6.78pp VWAP edge is real and meaningful.
